title: AI Coding Dictionary: AI coding jargon, explained in plain English

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Matt PCO is leading the crusade against messy vibe coding. Dictionary of AI coding is his newest drop. Looks like a comprehensive open- source glossery of modern AI concepts. Tracer bullets, evals, agentic harnesses, but it's formatted as an agentnative reference module injected directly into your LLM's context. grounds your agent in strict industry standard definitions instead of hallucinated interpretations.
